independence.interpretation: Distinct recorded Xoshiro point seeds verified; this is a provenance/stream-reuse check, not a statistical proof of RNG independence.

pooling.policy: Old production only, restricted to exactly the fresh channel/size/probability cells; no new rates/sizes from old data.

protocol.feedback_timing: after transfers 1:T inclusive; no separate r=0 correction

protocol.full_prefix: complete physical recovery on all available data slices Q0..Qr after EVERY transfer 1:T, including the last; complete-prefix syndrome zero; exactly one final recovery and logical outcome afterward
